1.explanation: This minimal create-react-app–style example pulls in carbon-components-react@7.9.1 and renders four <Tab> items.  Each <a> element in the tab list will have aria-posinset and aria-setsize attributes set from the Carbon source, but when you activate VoiceOver (VO) on macOS 10.14.6 in Chrome 79 and navigate the tabs, VO will announce “1 of 1” for every tab.  This reproduces the bug where VoiceOver ignores the aria-setsize value and always reports the group size as 1.
1.bug_scenario: When rendering a group of Carbon React <Tabs> (carbon-components-react@7.9.1) on macOS 10.14.6 in Chrome 79 with VoiceOver enabled, VO only ever announces “X, selected, tab, 1 of 1” for each tab, even though there are multiple tabs in the set.  You can see in the DOM that each anchor has aria-posinset and aria-setsize set properly, but VoiceOver ignores aria-setsize and always reports the group size as 1.
